content.text: BAWIPA teh pholen awh.
Oe BAWIPA koe lunghawilawk dei awh.
Bangkongtetpawiteh, ama teh ahawi.
A lungmanae teh a yungyoe a kangning.
BAWIPA ni a sak e thaonae hah
apinimaw a dei thai han.
Apinimaw pholennae pueng
koung a pholen thai han.
Nâtuek haiyah kalan lah ka tawksak e hoi
lannae kâuepkhai e teh, tami yawkahawi e lah ao.
Oe BAWIPA na rawi e naw e hawinae hah
ka hmu thai nahanlah thoseh,
na miphun lunghawinae koe
ka lunghawi nahan nange râw lah
kaawmnaw hoi cungtalah lunghawi nahanelah thoseh,
Na taminaw ni a coe awh e na ngaikhainae hah
na pahnim hanh lah a.
Rungngangnae hoi pâtam haw.
Mintoenaw hoi reirei ka payon awh toe.
Yonnae hah ka sak awh teh, hnokathout ka sak awh toe.
Mintoenaw ni Izip ram vah kângairu hno
na sak e hah thaipanuek awh hoeh.
na Lungmanae apapnae hai pâkuem awh hoeh.
Tuipui paling teng patenghai taran a thaw awh.
Hatei, amae min thaonae bahu hoi duengdoeh na rungngang.
A hnosakthainae hoi a thaonae
panue sak thai nahane doeh.
Tuipui paling hai a yue teh rem a hak.
Hottelah ka dungpoung e tui a raka awh teh,
kahrawngum vah a hrawi.
Ama kahmuhmanaw e kut dawk hoi a rungngang teh,
tarannaw kut dawk hoi a ratang.
Tarannaw hah tui ni koung a muem teh,
buet touh hai ka hring e awm hoeh.
Hottelah a lawk hah a yuem awh teh,
ama pholen hoi la a sak awh.
A sak awh e hah tang a pahnim awh teh,
a noenae hah coe ngai awh hoeh.
Hatei, kahrawngum vah takthai
ngainae a len dawkvah,
kahrawngum vah Cathut hah a tanouk awh.
A hei awh e hah a poe.
Hatei, muitha hringnae dawk kamsoenae hah a poe sin.
A roe awhnae koe Mosi hah a ut awh teh,
Oe BAWIPA tamikathoung Aron hai a ut awh.
Talai ni a pahni a ang teh, Dathan hah a payawp.
Abiram e taminaw hah koung a ramuk.
Ahnimouh koehoi hmai a tâco teh,
tamikathoutnaw hmai koung a kak.
Horeb vah maitoca meikaphawk hah a sak awh teh,
sakhlawn meikaphawk hah a bawk awh.
Hottelah a bawilennae teh,
phovai ka cat e maitotan patetlah a coung sak awh.
Izip vah hno kalennaw a sak e hoi,
Ham vah a sak e kângairu hnonaw hoi,
tuipuipaling koe e takikatho hno a sak e naw hoi
ahnimouh ka rungngangkung Cathut teh a pahnim awh.
Hat toteh, a rawi e Mosi ni,
a lungkhueknae hah takhoe vaiteh,
ahnimanaw raphoe hoeh nahanelah,
raphoenae hmuen, a hmalah kangdout hoeh pawiteh,
ahnimanaw raphoe han telah a kâcai.
Hathnukkhu, kahawi e ram teh a pacekpahlek awh teh,
a lawk hah yuem ngai awh hoeh.
Amamae rimnaw hah a phuenang sin awh teh,
BAWIPA e lawk hah tarawi ngai awh hoeh.
Hatdawkvah, ahnimouh teh kahrawngum vah
koung due sak hanelah thoseh,
A catounnaw hai miphunlouknaw koe
tâkhawng hanelah hoi ram tangkuem kâkapek sak hane thoseh,
ahnimae a vang lah thoe a bo.
Ahnimouh teh Peor e Baal hoi a kâkuet awh teh,
tami kadout hmalah thueng e hno hah a ca awh.
Hottelah a sak awh e hno ni a lungkhuek sak teh,
ahnimouh koe lacik kathout hah a tha pouh.
Hatnavah, Phinehas a kangdue teh,
lawk a ceng navah lacik teh a roum.
Hothateh, ama lannae lah a yungyoe hoi se pueng dawk,
pouk pouh e lah ao.
Meribah tui koehai a lungkhuek sak awh teh,
ahnimouh kecu dawk Mosi koe
totouh thoebonae teh a pha.
Mosi e a lungthin a
tarawk awh dawkvah,
pouk laipalah ahni teh lawk a dei.
BAWIPA ni a dei e patetlah sak hoeh.
Miphunlouknaw raphoe laipalah ao awh.
Jentelnaw hoi a kâkalawt awh teh,
ahnimae hringnuen hah a kamtu awh.
Ahnimae meikaphawk thaw hah a tawk awh.
Hothateh ahnimouh hanelah karap doeh.
A capanaw hah thueng nahanelah a poe awh teh,
a canunaw hah kahrai koe a poe awh.
Yon ka tawn hoeh e thi hah a rabawk awh teh,
a capanaw hoi a canunaw e thi hoi roeroe vah,
Kanaan ram meikaphawk cathut thuengnae lah
a hno awh teh, hottelah thipalawng e lahoi
ram a khin sak awh.
Hottelah a sak awh e hno hoi roeroe a kâkhinsak awh,
a sak awh e hoi roeroe a yon awh.
Hatdawkvah, BAWIPA lungkhueknae teh
a taminaw taran lahoi a kaman teh,
a râw lah kaawm e hah a panuet.
Ahnimanaw teh Jentel kut dawk a poe teh,
a hmuhma e naw ni a uk awh.
A taran ni rep a coungroe awh teh,
a kut rahim vah ao awh.
Avai moikapap a rungngang toe.
Hatei, amamouh khokhannae dawk hoi
taran a thaw awh teh,
amamae payonnae ni a rahnoum sak awh.
Hatei, runae a kâhmo awh toteh
a hram awh e ka thai pouh teh,
ahnimouh han pouk pouh laipalah awm thai hoeh.
Ahnimouh kecu dawk a lawkkam teh pou a panue teh,
a lungmanae apap dawkvah, a pahren awh.
San lah kahrawinaw e lungthin dawk hai
ahnimouh a pahren sak.
Na min kathoung dawk lunghawinae lawk dei hane hoi,
na pholennae dawk tânae hmu hanelah,
Oe BAWIPA maimae Cathut, na rungngang haw.
Jentel miphun thung hoi cungtalah
bout na pâkhueng haw.
Isarel BAWIPA Cathut teh,
a yungyoe hoi a yungyoe totouh, pholen lah awm seh.
Tami pueng ni Amen tet naseh.
BAWIPA teh pholen awh.
